returns  (c_kem, c_dem)
state Scheme_KEM
state Scheme_DEM
state Scheme_PKE
state MON_CCA_PKE
  c = Some((c_kem, c_dem))
  unchanged: pk, sk
randomness
  Scheme_KEM.KEM_ENCAPS.kem_encaps +1
where
  r#0 = sample Bits(kencr) @ Scheme_KEM.KEM_ENCAPS.kem_encaps #0
  pk = unwrap(old.MON_CCA_PKE.pk)
  c_kem = kem_encaps(r#0, pk).2
  c_dem = dem_enc(kem_encaps(r#0, pk).1, m1)
